goal: Introduce the five paths as collectible pirate-persona cards, available as browseable overview.

content.title: مسارات GDGoC
content.subtitle: خمس شخصيات، هدف واحد: نبني معًا مجتمع أقوى

reference_composition.scene: Near-black wood ship interior, title/subtitle centered at top, 5 tall illustrated cards placed in one horizontal lineup.
reference_composition.card_geometry: tall 1:2.5-ish slender rounded-corner playing cards with bright colored outline
reference_composition.character_position: upper ~70% each card, full body pirate character clipped within tinted frame
reference_composition.bottom_region: dark transparent gradient with neon track icon above two-line Arabic label
reference_composition.deck_details: Small chipped decorative pixel corners and faint silhouette background per card.

interaction.card_click: Navigate to available /result/:trackId or a generic track introduction when result copy has not been approved. Do not falsely display a personality test result simply because a card was clicked.
interaction.selected: Distinct highlight if representing actual user result.

mobile_layout.intro: Centered heading and one-to-three lines of subtitle at top with side gutters.
mobile_layout.card_display: Horizontal scroll-snap carousel of roughly 68-76vw wide tall cards; one central card fully visible with side preview.
mobile_layout.alternative: Accessible all-tracks vertical list or toggle for people who do not want horizontal scrolling.
mobile_layout.card_height: Use aspect ratio ~0.62 (wide enough to keep Arabic title legible); clamp maximum around 500px.
mobile_layout.navigation: Visible swipe hint, 5 progress bullets and/or previous/next controls; do not trap vertical scrolling.
mobile_layout.illustrations: Keep face and hands inside card when resized; bottom title region never covered by character.
